trigger: A completed or interim study must communicate evidence to stakeholders or another profession.
steps: Name the decision/question the report informs without turning it into a product decision.
Bind every finding to study method, sample/context and traceable observations.
Separate observation, interpretation, contradiction and inference.
Choose audience-appropriate tables/visuals/examples while preserving source traceability.
State transferability limits, missing evidence and competing interpretations.
Create explicit handoffs for quantitative inference, product priority, design action, accessibility or privacy decisions.
forbidden: Convert participant anecdotes into prevalence without suitable design/inference.
Hide contradictory observations for narrative clarity.
Turn a research report into a product/design command by researcher authority.
